scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Three positive-length arcs with common endpoints, intrinsic shortest-path metric, two independent arclength-uniform points. Exact closed cubic, global sharp equal-length lower bound, and non-Schur-convexity.
limitations: No assertion of a general graph-topology optimizer.
An original 1982 paper with restricted three-parallel-edge examples could not be read in full.
Computations supplement but do not replace a symbolic proof.

title: Exact intrinsic mean distance and sharp balancing law for three-path theta graphs
